name: Tic-Tac-Toe vs Minimax Engine
summary: The engine searches every line of play. Against it, the best you can get is a draw.
rules: You are X and move first. Enter the number of an empty square (1 to 9). Three in a row wins.
engine: Minimax search over the whole game. It never misses a win or a block.

name: Nim vs Perfect Engine
summary: Three piles of objects. The engine solves the game exactly and plays perfectly.
rules: Take any number of objects from one pile. Whoever takes the last object wins. You go first.
engine: Exact search of every position. If it can win, it does.

name: Connect Four vs Search Engine
summary: Drop discs into seven columns. The engine looks four moves ahead and blocks your threats.
rules: You are X and move first. Enter a column (1 to 7). Four of your discs in a line wins.
engine: Alpha-beta search four moves deep, with a score for threats and centre control.

name: Rock-Paper-Scissors vs Pattern Engine
summary: Twenty rounds. The engine learns which move you favour and plays to beat it.
rules: Choose rock, paper or scissors each round (r, p or s). The engine chooses without seeing your choice in that round.
engine: Predicts your most common move so far and plays the move that beats it.

name: Colonel Blotto vs Adaptive Commander
summary: Split six units across three fronts. A front goes to the side with more units there.
rules: Each round, send three whole numbers that add up to 6, for example 2 2 2. You win a round by taking more fronts than the engine. The commander sends its units without seeing yours in that round.
engine: Chooses the split that does best against your past splits, so repeating a split gets punished.

name: Border Patrol vs Adaptive Guard
summary: You try to slip past one of three gates. The guard watches one gate each round.
rules: Each round, pick a gate (1, 2 or 3). You get through if the guard is watching another gate. Twelve rounds: get through more than six times to win.
engine: Guards the gate you have used most often, so a player who favours one gate is caught.
